src/metrics-connector.ts.summary: validatedMetricsUrl: https OR http-loopback-only (127.0.0.1/[::1]/localhost/host.docker.internal — the containerized hub reaches host-published LiteLLM through the docker gateway name, operator-declared in 0600 stack config), no userinfo/search/hash, pathname /metrics only. readPrivateKey: absolute path, mode EXACTLY 0600, owner uid match, 1..4096 bytes, no newlines. Config law: url xor keyFile/keyEnv — keyFile and keyEnv mutually exclusive, env name must match /^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$/; not_configured when all absent. Bounded read: content-length pre-check + streamed cap 2MiB -> too_large. Content-type must be text/plain or openmetrics. expose(): source_up gauges (buckle always 1, litellm 1 iff ok) + combined body; status rides x-buckle-litellm-metrics-status header + optional source-id (stable engine identity — shared scrapes are not additive) + http status. Statuses: ok|not_configured|invalid_config|key_unavailable|http_error|timeout|unavailable|too_large|wrong_content_type|empty.

src/stream-semantics.ts.role: W1106 body-free semantic outcome classifier: a protocol terminal (anthropic message_stop / openai [DONE]) alone is NOT proof of a completed turn — the empty-stream incident shipped protocol-perfect turns with no usable output (exact 483-byte envelope: message_start + usage-only terminal + message_stop)
src/stream-semantics.ts.summary: Three booleans accumulated while a stream flows, reduced to ONE typed failure kind at the terminal: empty_response (no usable text/tool/refusal ever) | reasoning_only (only thinking deltas) | output_token_limit (ended on max_tokens/length with no output). Usage counters deliberately NOT evidence (out_tok 0 is the symptom not the proof — the 483B envelope carried usage 33341/0). No text ever stored — booleans only. Bilingual: anthropic delta/block text + tool_use NAME is the commitment (args stream later) + thinking/redacted_thinking + stop_reason max_tokens; openai delta content/refusal + reasoning_content + finish_reason length + named tool_calls; Responses wire (W912) output_item/message output_text/refusal/output_audio + named function_call + response.completed snapshot walked item by item. W2579 live outputEvidence() {outputFrames, roleFrames} — counts the frame that FIRST flipped each boolean, read by the receipt's role-only classification at an idle-deadline kill BEFORE any terminal reduction. emptyStreamError() typed error body shared by both bridge directions.

src/stream-terminal.ts.role: stream finalization helpers extracted from handlers.ts (W1265 cap pay-down): the W1106 audit terminal classifier, sniff-branch sink, once-guard, mid-stream error events, scrubbed error-text face — leaf module (imports only adapters/errors + sse + error-trace prefix, never handlers)
src/stream-terminal.ts.summary: terminalOf precedence: downstream_cancel > gateway_restarting (drained) > in_band_error:<code> (an in-band failure body outranks a terminal marker #55446) > upstream_eof_truncated (#55420 EOF without protocol terminal) / upstream_eof > timeout: upstream_deadline vs upstream_deadline_role_only (W2579 C235 role-only shape) > upstream_error:<kind>. scrubText: /Users/<name> -> ~ before any error leaves. blackHole: sniff-branch sink (bytes in, usage extraction + progress counters out). writeErrorEvent: mid-stream upstream death appends dialect-correct error event with trace stamp (fleet_trace hops entry, 502/stream_failed) then closes; RouterError reuses routerErrorEnvelope.

src/stream-correlation.ts.role: W2260 provider-neutral hop/trace correlation for streaming responses — bounded transport metadata ONLY (upstream_request_id, litellm_call_id, activity class), never prompt or key content
src/stream-correlation.ts.summary: Four-way activity split answering the W2260 incident question (HTTP 200, 188 bytes, 60s idle, provider-side close?) without payload: semantic (>=1 non-keepalive data frame) | role_only (W2579: frames arrived but NONE carried usable output or reasoning — the C235 role-frame-then-silence shape, distinct from mid-content stalls which stay semantic) | ping_only (only keepalives) | none (true no-byte stall). StreamReceipt: terminal + bytes_in/chunks_in + last_chunk_ms + activity + retry_eligible (failed/truncated with zero client-visible semantic output could retry without duplicating) + upstream_request_id/litellm_call_id (safeCorrelationId junk-filtered, null = honest unknown). hopCorrelationOf reads x-buckle-upstream-request-id/x-request-id/x-litellm-call-id from SUCCESS-stream headers (failure path already classified them in router-attempt).

src/sse-heartbeat.ts.role: final-established SSE egress heartbeat: injects a comment keepalive when the wire has been quiet >= 25s so client proxies do not time out — comments never enter upstream guards, sniffers, usage, or model-progress counters
src/sse-heartbeat.ts.summary: withSseHeartbeats wraps the FINAL established stream only. Byte-level boundary tracker (CRLF-aware) maintains lineHasBytes/commentLine/eventOpen so a comment is NEVER injected mid-event or mid-line — only at clean quiet boundaries when desiredSize>0 and lastBytesAt is stale. Backpressure law: one queued comment + at most ONE borrowed upstream chunk retained under downstream pressure (pending slot); pump gated on desiredSize. AbortSignal honored once (controller.error + source cancel); reader.closed watched for source-finished (disarm timer). HeartbeatClock seam (now/schedule, unref'd timer) for deterministic tests — not an operator knob. SSE_QUIET_HEARTBEAT_MS = 25s.

src/latency-report.ts.role: W2247/W2247.1 diagnostic: request size vs transport latency over route_attempt transport evidence; headersMs and firstBodyByteMs reported SEPARATELY and never conflated — headersMs is time-to-headers (non-streaming includes the WHOLE generation: the 2026-10-29 trace 912KB body, headersMs 76562, 4106 out-tokens ~18.6ms/token ≈ 76s), so the historical size-vs-latency finding is a HEADERS finding
src/latency-report.ts.summary: firstBodyByteMs aggregated from OBSERVED values only — rows without one excluded, never backfilled from headersMs (null when no observation, NaN Pearson -> null, never fabricated). LatencyRow = (transport_json, stream_receipt?, queue_wait_ms?) pulled by the caller (module pure, testable against scratch db). Buckets <10k/10-100k/100-500k/500k+; per-bucket hdr p50/p90/max + fb p50/p90/max/n + reqKB avg + queueWait p50. Pearson requestBytes x headersMs and requestBytes x firstBodyByteMs. Streaming vs non-streaming headersMs p50 split. renderReport: fixed-width table, '—' for unknown.

src/otlp-export.ts.role: W2788 out-of-band per-request trace export: every proxied request settles one buckle.proxy span (wire-stamp settle) and, when usage observed, one buckle.usage child span (OTel GenAI keys); spans queue in a BOUNDED ring (drop-oldest, counted) and flush batched as OTLP/HTTP JSON to ${endpoint}/v1/traces
src/otlp-export.ts.summary: Env-off by default: no BUCKLE_OTLP_ENDPOINT = no ring, no timer, no I/O. Malformed knobs FAIL LOUD at boot (OtlpConfigSchema zod, prettified). Knobs: SAMPLE (default 1), RING 1024, BATCH 64, FLUSH_MS 2000, hub id from BUCKLE_HUB_ID. Sampling is PER TRACE (low 32 bits of trace id / 2^32 < rate) — a request's spans travel together. Export never blocks or fails a request; a collector miss drops the batch (failed count). Flush singleflight (inflight promise chained). toOtlpSpan: kind 2 SERVER, BigInt nanos, attrs typed bool/int/double/string, null/undefined attrs omitted. setOtlpExporterForTest seam. KNOB_REGISTRY: these are BUCKLE_* not SUSPENDERS_* knobs.

src/otlp-request-spans.ts.role: W2788 the two buckle settle points mapped onto OTLP spans: buckle.proxy at wire-stamp settle (verdict/hop/model_group/lane/key NAME — key material never rides, only the trusted mint name); buckle.usage at the usage record, parenting on the proxy span; inert when the exporter is off
src/otlp-request-spans.ts.summary: proxySpanId minted on first touch via WeakMap<Ctx> — non-streaming bodies record usage BEFORE the stamp settles, streams after; either order parents correctly. Proxy attrs: rid, hop (relay|ingress by peer), model_group, gen_ai.request.model + gen_ai.response.model (served), gen_ai.provider.name, lane, key_name, verdict, refusal, error_code, attempts, streaming, dialect, http.response.status_code; error = status >= 500. Usage span: honest-null law — null usage = no span (never zero-faked); gen_ai.usage input/output + cache_read/cache_creation tokens.

src/observation-export.ts.role: bounded read-only export of the hub's projected CloudEvents (obs_events) — admin gate authenticates callers; cursor = local SQLite rowid order while source+id remains the durable cross-hub dedup key
src/observation-export.ts.summary: MAX_EVENTS 64, MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES 256KiB (byte-weighted sum incl. source/id + 128 overhead; exceeding THROWS — page shrinks, never truncates). generation = first retained event's source/id/time — identifies the projection generation after a reset. Cursor rewind law: cursor > maxCursor (projection recreated) restarts at 0; the receiver dedups by source+id when it sees the rewind. limit+1 fetch row gives hasMore. readonly DB, throw on unavailable projection.

src/cache-boundary.ts.role: W458.4 cache-boundary honesty + per-lane cache telemetry: a cache boundary is (provider, tenant, region, model); matching requests reuse provider cache ONLY inside one boundary; presence of a matching entry never guarantees a hit (routing + expiry decide)
src/cache-boundary.ts.summary: Tenant comes from the CREDENTIAL's identity (api_key_env NAME never the value; keyless fleet-local falls back to URL origin), never from request text. Cache keys are routing/accounting aids, NEVER authorization: boundary data may downgrade a reuse EXPECTATION (hitExpectation: possible | impossible-boundary | impossible-model — model mismatch is its own impossibility even within one tenant) but never grants/relaxes/collapses a tenant (mayShareCachePopulation = sameBoundary ONLY). rideGateKeyOf (the cache-motivated steering gate): account+region+family+model — URL origin deliberately ABSENT (same-account fleet worker steering is routing, not tenant collapse). LaneTelemetryLog: append-only NDJSON (survives restart, failover reads same attribution back), corrupt lines skipped never fatal, hitShare = cacheRead / (inTok+cacheRead+cacheWrite). W926 prefix_fp (keyed digest of delivered prefix) + miss_cause (changed-prefix | provider-eviction | null unknown) per row. boundaryOfDeployment keeps the module leaf-pure (narrow BoundaryDep, no upstreams.ts import).

src/outbound-guard.ts.role: W1257.1 configurable outbound egress guard: a deployment declares outbound URL PATH prefixes its credential must never fetch (adapter_config.blocked_outbound, config-over-code — the Z.ai Coding Plan seat blocks the general /api/paas/v4 inference endpoint while a general key keeps it, never a hardcoded all-keys ban)
src/outbound-guard.ts.summary: Runs in defaultFetch AFTER the adapter-built URL (post path_rewrite) BEFORE fetch — throws OutboundBlockedError (RouterError kind bad_request 400, NON-retryable: the ladder benches the rung and walks on) before any network side effect. Wire naming: the ingress POST path decides the wire (/v1/messages anthropic, /v1/responses responses, /v1/chat/completions openai; default openai) — never request headers; corrections are per-wire FULL URLs so the error URL always matches the actual wire; message names the Coding Plan destination + other wires. Path-prefix match: exact | trailing-slash prefix | prefix + '/'. validateOutboundGuardConfig at pool load: startup-fatal on malformed rows (absolute paths, corrections keyed by known wire with absolute http(s) URL), like the egress law before it.

src/drain.ts.role: the ONE gateway drain state (W1156): a planned redeploy is positively known ONLY from beginDrain via EXPLICIT deploy intent (root ruling 2026-10-22: a bare SIGTERM is never proof — an unexpected shutdown keeps its real cause, no gateway_restarting terminal); every other break keeps its real cause — the drain never labels a break it did not observe
src/drain.ts.summary: beginDrain idempotent (first reason wins; second signal null no-op), arms an unref'd force-exit backstop at the grace deadline (a drain can never outlive its grace), notifies listeners once (failing observer never blocks). onDrain: a listener registered WHILE draining fires immediately (a stream born mid-drain gets its terminal at once). drainTerminalFrame: dialect-correct SSE terminal (anthropic event:error {type:'error'} vs openai bare data server_error), code gateway_restarting + request_id + retry guidance; trace stamps regex-validated (32-hex id, sane hub) with fleet_trace hops entry status 200. writeDrainTerminal (W1156): enqueue + ctl.terminate() — the ONLY termination TransformStreamDefaultController has in Bun (typeof close === 'undefined'; probe 2026-10-22); a drain racing a closed/errored stream throws, delivers nothing, receipt keeps the real cause. resetDrainForTest seam clears the backstop timer (a leaked timer would kill the test run).

src/cost.ts.role: W1132 per-request cost: versioned model price table + pure per-row computation the ledger applies at write time (Helicone pattern: every priced row stamps the rate version, historical repricing possible); rates are OPERATOR CONFIG (routing-policy.json cost block), never code, never guessed
src/cost.ts.summary: Never-silently-zero law: a model without a rate row is cost-UNSUPPORTED (CostOf null — ledger stores NULL, every reader treats as unknown spend); a declared $0 rate is a legitimate stamped zero; an undeclared cache discount bills cache tokens at FULL input rate (no savings claimed until the operator measures one — ZAI prefix caching stays unpriced-as-savings). in_tok_includes_cache switch: true = OpenAI shape (in_tok INCLUDES cached subset — cached bills at multiplier, remainder at full rate, clamped), false/absent = Anthropic ADDITIVE shape. Multipliers bounded [0,10] (multOf default 1 = conservative no-savings). buildCostPolicy fail-CLOSED like provider_pools: malformed table refuses startup loudly (version REQUIRED — a table without a version prices NOTHING: cannot stamp, will not guess); validRates is the read-time backstop.

src/budgets.ts.role: O(1) in-process budget books (W143 speed §3): rpm/tpm as 60-slot per-second rings with incrementally-maintained rolling sums, token budget as one integer per key — a check is field loads + compare, no allocation beyond the verdict, no scan, no I/O
src/budgets.ts.summary: Limits from policy budgets: block (key '*' = default book, named key = sha-prefix ledger id overrides). advance() slides the ring zeroing evicted slots keeping sums exact (gap >= 60 = fill(0) fast path). check() verdicts: rate_rpm | rate_tpm | budget_spent; spendRequest/spendTokens after a passing check (tokens also decrement lifetime remaining). Enforcement wiring is W141's surface — this module is the constant-time engine. NOTE: distinct from src/gov/budgets.ts (enterprise token-budgets ledger) — duplication-suspect pair with different jobs (in-process rings vs durable org budgets).
flags: dup-suspect: vs gov/budgets.ts (different jobs — in-process rings vs durable org token budgets)

src/cache-fingerprint.ts.role: W926 privacy-safe prefix fingerprints classifying per-lane cache misses: W914/W915 saw misses land 17-20s after hits on the same model — indistinguishable from tokens alone; a keyed digest of the EFFECTIVE prefix (post-alignment system/tools/packet/breakpoint bytes as delivered upstream) separates provider-eviction from changed-prefix
src/cache-fingerprint.ts.summary: Classification: same digest + miss = provider-eviction/expiry (dropped an entry we re-verified byte-stable); different digest + miss = changed-prefix; no prior reference / unobserved usage / no reported cache write = null (never guessed). Privacy: HMAC-SHA256 keyed with process-random key (BUCKLE_FINGERPRINT_KEY env pin across restarts), truncated 16 hex = 64 bits — prompt bytes never logged, digest equality the only signal leaving the process. Prefix bounds: deepest explicit cache_control marker (its exact POSITION rides the digest — moving a marker moves the effective prefix even with identical bytes); no marker = implicit openai-family prefix = whole message sequence. stable(): key-order-stable canonical serialization (arrays keep order — message order is semantic). PrefixLedger: single-slot per (boundary, lane) — banked on hits and confirmed writes (observe), miss classified against it (cause); LRU-bounded 4096 like the affinity memo.

src/usage-record.ts.role: one completed proxied request -> ledger row + servicemon token counters + per-lane cache telemetry (honest unknown everywhere); the single settle seam joining audit row (W457 cache_r/cache_c), OTLP usage span (W2788), lane cache boundary row (W458.4), W926 miss classification, and the W2790 token-budget settle
src/usage-record.ts.summary: usage null = honest unknown: requests column still increments, token columns contribute NOTHING, servicemon gets explicit buckle_usage_unknown_total counter — never estimated, never faked as real zeros. W926 miss classification: a miss WITH a reported cache write (cache_r===0 && cache_c>0) is comparable — provider just wrote this exact prefix, banked reference equal = provider-eviction, differing = changed-prefix; hits and confirmed writes re-bank the reference. Lane row rides boundaryOfDeployment(head.dep) — the boundary actually ridden. W2790: real usage joins the monthly book at settle; the ingress reservation already holds the weighted input estimate so the book errs HIGH (never under); usage null settles nothing. ctx.model names the model so the ledger prices at enqueue (W1132).

src/hop.ts.role: W706 hop attribution: verified origin hub vs immediate peer so a RELAYED request bills once; baggage header is the carrier (fleet allowlist in trace.ts gates keys); the hub seeing NO peer marker is the origin = designated billing source, every downstream hop marks its audit row forwarded
src/hop.ts.summary: Baggage keys: fleet.origin.hub.id / fleet.peer.hub.id / fleet.lane.id (lane = telemetry only, same slug as /w/<lane>, bounded 128 + validated charset). hopBaggageOf: origin passes through (self when none received), peer seat CLAIMED (self), other allowlisted entries preserved — fleet-internal legs only (buckle-marked deployments, authenticated); baggage never rides external-provider egress. HopKind origin|forwarded rides route_audit.hop — 'origin' rows billable, 'forwarded' rows per-hop evidence never billed again. W3C list parse: value = segment before ';', length-bounded 128.

src/admission.ts.role: W450 bounded RPC admission for the proxy path: every in-flight upstream RPC (headers through FULL body drain) holds one slot — the pass-through socket lives as long as the client keeps reading, so the bound covers the whole stream not just the walk
src/admission.ts.summary: Past cap: 429 + Retry-After (belt router-shim precedent — the router never queues blindly; client retries or its ladder falls through). DEFAULT_MAX_INFLIGHT 256, RETRY_AFTER_S 2. BUCKLE_GROUP_CAPS 'group:4,...' parse (malformed entries DROPPED never fatal, cap regex [\w.-]+:\d{1,4}). W1118 #55680: per-group cap AND global max BOTH bind — a group cap above max never multiplies the global bound (MAX_INFLIGHT=1 admits one across ALL groups). tryAcquire returns a release fn (idempotent) or null; counts map deletes empty group keys.

src/usage.ts.role: usage extraction from response payloads, both dialects; absent usage = honest unknown (callers record requests without token columns rather than estimating)
src/usage.ts.summary: OpenAI shape: usage.{prompt_tokens|input_tokens, completion_tokens|output_tokens, prompt_tokens_details|input_tokens_details.cached_tokens} — cache_c always 0 (no write field). Anthropic shape: {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens}; SSE sniffer unwraps (message_start .message vs message_delta flat .usage) and feeds the FLAT object here. hasTokens gate: all-zero usage returns null. cacheUsageReported: cache support observed ONLY via an explicit field — a zero count without it is NOT a cache miss. cacheWriteReported: anthropic-only (cache_creation field); a cache READ field does not imply writes are reported.

src/count-tokens.ts.role: local EXPLICITLY approximate count for configured models whose upstream dialect has no native Anthropic count_tokens endpoint — never calls an unsupported provider path, never records the estimate as billed usage
src/count-tokens.ts.summary: CountTokensBodySchema zod passthrough (model + messages). inputTokens = max(1, tokensEstimate(bytes/4 of the whole body)). Full audit decision row: decision 'local_estimate', latency_class 'unproven', allow_cloud false, why names the approximation; auditOutcome 200 ok. Response header x-klh-token-count-method: estimated-bytes-v1 — the honest marker. stamped() wire stamp with attempts 0.

src/served-identity.ts.role: the served-model/provider identity trust rule: ONLY an explicitly configured, authenticated Buckle peer (dep.buckle) is authoritative for its delivered route via x-klh-served-* response headers; client headers and wire dialect NEVER name a provider
src/served-identity.ts.summary: servedIdentity: peer headers (bounded regex, model charset allows ./:@+ up to 256) ?? configured deployment fields; evidence = peer | configured | unknown. stampServedIdentity sets/deletes the three headers (null deletes). requestedEffort: output_config.effort ?? body.reasoning_effort, whitelisted to the 8-level enum (none..ultra).

src/worker-inventory.ts.role: relay to the desktop runner's /v1/workers inventory listener — LOOPBACK ONLY (http + 127.0.0.1/[::1] literal origin, no userinfo/search/hash, pathname '/'): the listener shares the gateway host, so the caller bearer never leaves the host
src/worker-inventory.ts.summary: resolveWorkerInventoryOrigin: explicit inventoryPort wins (validated 1..65535, must differ from Buckle's own port — throws); else desktopOrigin only if loopback http. workerInventoryRelay: re-validates literal loopback at construction; forwards the caller's authorization VERBATIM (bearer stays on loopback), redirect: error, 1.5s timeout, response body passed through with json/no-store; 401 problem without bearer, 503 problem on listener miss.

src/lane-wrap.ts.role: W2 caveman adopt 2: ephemeral config-file injection for codex-class lanes — buildWrap() is a pure plan, materializeWrap() writes the temp config home (dir 0700, file 0600) the recipe's configHomeEnv points at
src/lane-wrap.ts.summary: The user's real config is NEVER read or mutated by the lane path — self-contained configs by design (deep-merging user TOML needs a parser dep; deliberate non-goal). Rendered configs reference secrets by ENV NAME only (env_key = 'LITELLM_KEY'), never values — codex reads the env itself. Null plan for recipes without an ephemeral block (pure-env recipes like claude/copilot don't wrap). materializeWrap: mkdtemp + chmod 0700, write 0600 + chmod again (umask can mask the write mode); fails closed — any error propagates, a lane never launches half-injected. Persistent enable stays the explicit onboard step (bin/onboard.ts configEdit); temp home cleaned by the launcher (bin/lane-wrap.ts --run wires cleanup to child exit).

src/log.ts.role: W2173.7 the ONE leveled-logger seam for the fleet (a single module both packages ride); levels filtered by BUCKLE_LOG_LEVEL (default info), one line per event '<prefix> <LEVEL> <message>'
src/log.ts.summary: warn/error ride stderr, debug/info stdout — a boot log and a failure log must never share a pipe. LEVEL_ORDER ascending; filter = at-or-above configured level; unknown/absent env keeps default. createLogger(scope) binds prefix 'buckle:<scope>'; LogSink seam for tests.

src/trace-url.ts.role: W2268 clickable error traces: the bounded trace_id/error-hop contract gains ONE client affordance — a details URL the Fleet console serves; operator config (BUCKLE_TRACE_URL_BASE), provider-neutral, HTTPS anywhere or plain-HTTP-loopback-only, never a provider URL, never a fabricated page
src/trace-url.ts.summary: Inert by default (no base = null — like the other provider-neutral knobs). Base validation: <=512 bytes, no userinfo/search/hash, acceptableOrigin https|http-loopback (console perimeter guards the page). traceUrl(): trace id charset-checked 32-hex FIRST, fixed pathname /console/trace, id as the only query param, both produced by the URL API's own encoding — deterministic, no hand-built concatenation, no client steering of path/query.

src/copilot-hub-routes.ts.role: Mac/hub split routing: keep Copilot model names on the Mac but send their first hop through the Docker IKEA Buckle — the hub owns the provider credential and model catalog
src/copilot-hub-routes.ts.summary: preferCopilotHub(local, hubGroups, hubUrl): every hub group gains a PEER deployment row FIRST ({url: hubUrl, buckle: true, dialect/adapter by claude- prefix (anthropic vs openai-compat), model: <group>, api_key_env: IKEA_HUB_KEY}), with existing hubUrl/api.githubcopilot.com rows filtered out; local fallback rows stay after. Throws when the hub has no groups or Mac upstreams are missing hub group names (fail-closed sync).

src/provider-admission-metrics.ts.role: Prometheus text render of provider-admission-core pool snapshots — configured account-pool IDs are the ONLY label: never requests or keys
src/provider-admission-metrics.ts.summary: 13 fields (active/queued/outstanding, base+adaptive gap ms, adaptive concurrency + ceiling, concurrency_limited/recovery totals, rate_limited/recovery totals, feedback epoch); _total suffix = counter else gauge; label value escaped (backslash, newline, quote); non-finite/negative values skipped (honest omission).

src/stack-config.ts.role: W230 buckle's zero-dep window into the ONE stack config (~/.config/klh/stack.json, mode 600, never committed; KLH_STACK overrides path; W1253 Amendment A: fleet config is JSON — legacy stack.yaml name parses when content is JSON)
src/stack-config.ts.summary: loadExecutors reads only the executors rows (per-executor anthropic_base/openai_base + model pin) the onboard + lane-wrap surfaces consume; env and CLI flags stay the override layer. Missing/malformed/oversized (>1MiB) config degrades to {} — a bad config NEVER blocks onboarding.

src/provider-pressure.ts.role: W1257 provider-pressure classification: a configured concurrency code ALONE cannot prove concurrency — Z.ai's 1302 says 'Rate limit reached for requests' and collapsed the live spoke pool to 1/50
src/provider-pressure.ts.summary: providerPressureOf: 'concurrency' ONLY when the code is in policy concurrencyErrorCodes AND the provider's own message carries explicit evidence (/\bconcurr(?:ent|ency|ing)\b/i); else 'rate'. assertProviderConcurrencyErrorCodes: startup-fatal validation — at most 16 UNIQUE bounded tokens (charset [A-Za-z0-9_.:-], 1-64).

src/error-response.ts.role: the buckle-GENERATED error body + scrub rule (W1259 extraction from handlers.ts — the file sat one line under the 1500-line hard limit, so the error face moved to its own module)
src/error-response.ts.summary: errorResponse: problem+json with stable code in `code` (http-citizenship); default code buckle.<slug by status>; provider-suffixed belt relay line when a provider code rides ('belt: <provider>.<code> — <why>'). scrubText: /Users/<name> paths -> ~ (key material never leaves through an error). Two DOCUMENTED exceptions stay documented: upstream pass-through errors ride the upstream body verbatim (client-error), mid-stream failures speak SSE (status already sent).

src/copilot-pat.ts.role: W2868 the Copilot PAT resolver, extracted from bin/copilot-seat-proof.ts so every pinned-relay probe shares one source
src/copilot-pat.ts.summary: Resolution order: explicit env GITHUB_COPILOT_PAT, then the CENTRAL provider profile bound to the same name (stack.json providers via @klh/speedy provider-config). The secret stays inside the calling process and is never printed (W1124.8.4 law). COPILOT_PAT_MISSING_MSG names both remedies.

src/forced-failover-drill.ts.role: bounded disposable routing drill: uses the PRODUCTION Router over the operator's configured group ladder but replaces every network call with deterministic failures/success — no provider or live lane touched
src/forced-failover-drill.ts.summary: Validates the plan fail-closed first: groups exist in pool, fallback is IN the configured ladder, maxAttempts >= 2 covers the fallback walk ((retries+1)*firstRungs), maxWallMs positive. Router seams fully deterministic: now() advances by simulated wait, rng()=0, probe()=null, sleepMs accumulates and throws past the wall budget, fetchImpl returns synthetic 429/503 (+retry-after) for the primary group and an ok response for the fallback (dialect-correct body). Wire attempts = receipts filtered hop!=='local-admission' paired with attemptedGroups. ok = delivered on the fallback tier without abort.

src/shadow-week.ts.role: the W144 shadow-week monitor's importable logic: bench-row parsing, scenario-keyed day diff, bounded 7-day log window (the operator face is bin/shadow-week.ts)
src/shadow-week.ts.summary: parseBenchRows: NDJSON, torn final line tolerated (crash mid-write). diffDay flags: gate-fail, gate-budget (p50>=5ms || p95>=15ms — wait, budgets are 5/15 in the GATE_BUDGET const), byte-identity<100 (except failover-mid-stream), tolerance p50/p95 >2x-prior, litellm up->down / down->up, missing-scenario; HARD flags (gate + byte-identity + budget) vs soft. First day (no prior) recorded never flagged. boundKeep: 7-day window, torn/foreign lines dropped.

src/affinity.ts.role: W237 prefix-affinity dispatch: lanes sharing a packet prefix ride the same provider identity within a TTL window so the provider's KV cache is hit instead of rebuilt; key = sha256-12 of the packet block's bytes (byte-stable packets — the preseed render law — hash equal when the window serves the same bytes)

src/pool-warm.ts.role: the warm-rate gate (W143 speed §2): Bun fetch already pools keep-alive sockets per origin (64-slot idle pool, oven-sh/bun#42608); buckle adds the observation seam + boot pre-warm
src/pool-warm.ts.summary: Cold is a HEURISTIC (Bun exposes no pool events): first use since boot/rebind or after an origin re-appears; the speed doc blesses exactly this (§6 idle-eviction timing unverified — shadow data will size it). observe(origin) counts the cold transition exactly once per origin then stays silent (returns cold at the transition); pool_refill event via sink (servicemon or bench collector). warmRate = 1 - refills/observes (null with no observations — honest). prewarm: one GET /v1/models per deployment origin, concurrent, never throws; ANY response (even 401/404) establishes the socket and marks warm WITHOUT a refill; network-error origins stay cold and their first real request pays (and counts) honestly. reset() bench seam.
